features.title: Barbarian Agility
features.description: While wearing light or no armor, you gain a +1 bonus to your Reflex defense and may use your Strength in place of Intelligence or Dexterity when calculating your AC score.

limitations: Shared local authoring definition; runtime interpretation and combat effects remain unimplemented.

features.title: Whirling Slayer
features.description: You gain the Whirling Lunge power, and you can wield one-handed weapons in your off hand without needing the off-hand property. Once per turn when you bloody a non-minion enemy or reduce a non-minion enemy to 0 hit points, you can shift a number of squares equal to half your *Dexterity* as a free action, and your next attack before the end of your next turn against any enemy adjacent to you after the shift gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls against those enemies. Increase this bonus to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 21st level.

features.title: Rage Strike
features.description:
Barbarian daily attack powers with the Rage keyword begin with an attack and let you enter a rage, granting an ongoing benefit until the rage ends. A rage lasts until the end of the encounter, until you enter another rage, or until you fall unconscious.

You gain the rage strike power. It lets you expend another daily rage power for a single attack while keeping your current rage.

features.title: Rampage
features.description: Once per round, when you score a critical hit with a barbarian attack power, you can make a melee basic attack as a free action. You do not have to attack the same target that you critically hit.
